DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。それとは別に、ナッツを避ける必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛さと別の食材制限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Separately from that, I also need to avoid nuts.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State an ingredient restriction separately from spiciness in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料と調理条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the ingredients and preparation conditions with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 辛くないならナッツもない、とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 低辛度と材料適合を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not assume that not being spicy means it contains no nuts either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish low spiciness from ingredient suitability in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補はこのカレーですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is this curry the dish you are considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。付け合わせも同じ条件で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付け合わせも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please check the side dishes under the same conditions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the side dishes to be checked as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一緒に頼む方も同じ制限ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the person ordering with you have the same restriction?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけです。友人の分まで変更する依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象は本人のみと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only I do. I am not asking you to change my friend's portion too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear in Japanese that only you are concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認前は注文を保留します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hold the order until the checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。辛さの希望と食材の制限を二つとも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二条件をまとめて引継ぎを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please pass on both my spice preference and my ingredient restriction.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for both conditions to be passed on together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人のカレーと付け合わせについて担当へ確認します。辛さだけで対応済みとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check your curry and side dishes with the responsible staff. We will not treat adjusting spiciness alone as having met your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り寄せのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss an item ordered in for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 黒を待っていますが、店頭の青へ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取寄せ色の変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting for the black one, but I would like to change to the blue one in the store.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request changing the color of the ordered-in item in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り寄せは到着していますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。青を買えば黒が自動取消とは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新購入と取消を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I do not assume buying the blue one automatically cancels the black one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a new purchase from cancellation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号で変更条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the change conditions using the order number.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。内金を払ったので扱いも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文番号と内金を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I paid a deposit, so I would like to ask how that will be handled too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the order number and deposit in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 価格差がある場合も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check any price difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 差額の説明まで、青の支払いは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差額確認前に支払わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait to pay for the blue one until the difference is explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not pay before checking the difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ両方の在庫と注文を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check both stocks and the order with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。黒の注文状態が分かってから一つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元注文の状態確認後に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will choose one after knowing the status of the black order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose after checking the original order's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更希望と内金の確認として承りました。今は両方を購入確定にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your request to change and check the deposit. We will not finalize purchases of both for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上の席へ手袋を置きました。取りに戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 置き忘れ回収の戻り方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left a glove on a seat upstairs. Can I go back to get it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to return to retrieve a forgotten item.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券と場所の目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your ticket and something identifying the seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 券はこちらです。窓の横の二人席でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券と席の目印を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the ticket. It was a two-person seat beside a window.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the ticket and seat landmarks in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再入場と回収方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check re-entry and retrieval arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出た後なので、券を見せれば自由に戻れるとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退出後の再入場条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since I have already left, I will not assume I can return freely just by showing the ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check re-entry conditions after leaving in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黒で内側に名前があります。片方は手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片方を保持し特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is black and has a name inside. I have the other glove with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you have one glove and describe its features in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will inquire with the retrieval staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。新しい券を買い直す前に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 買い直し前に係の照会を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here. Please check before I buy a new ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the staff's inquiry before buying another ticket and say so in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 片方を見本として担当へ引き継ぎます。今は出口の案内所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass the glove you have to the responsible staff as a reference. Please wait at the information desk by the exit for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は歩行者の案内です。車も自分が通してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行者担当の車両誘導可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am guiding pedestrians. Am I also allowed to direct vehicles through?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether pedestrian-guidance staff may direct vehicles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車両は別担当です。合図を混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Vehicles have separate staff. Please do not mix the signals.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。車両担当の位置と連絡方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別担当の位置と連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will ask where the vehicle staff are and how to contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the other staff's location and contact method in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作業車が来た時は担当へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: When a work vehicle arrives, we will contact the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩行者を横断させたまま、車を呼び込むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同時横断と車両誘導を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not wave a vehicle in while pedestrians are still crossing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid simultaneous pedestrian crossing and vehicle guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩行経路を確認してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仮設通路に段差があります。その情報も案内へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仮設経路の段差を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a step in the temporary passage. I would like that information included in the guidance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the step in the temporary route in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更は責任者へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will report any change to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自己判断で柵を動かさず、段差と二担当の連絡を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 柵を変更せず責任者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not move barriers on my own. I will pass on the step and how the two groups of staff should communicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not change barriers and will report to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 歩行者担当の範囲で待機してください。責任者が通路と車両側の連絡を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stand by within your pedestrian-guidance duties. The person in charge will check the passage and communication with vehicle staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a question about the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 貸出とある資料を借りたいです。利用カードが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示貸出表示の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to borrow the item labeled “On loan.” Do I need a user card?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the meaning of the exhibit's loan label in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは他館から借りて展示している表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This means it is borrowed from another institution for display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来館者への貸出ではないのですね。持ち帰らず閲覧方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来館者貸出でないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not available for visitors to borrow. I will not take it away; I will ask how to view materials instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand it is not a loan to visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示と閲覧室の資料は分けて案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can explain the exhibit and reading-room materials separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じテーマの本を閲覧室で見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: テーマ別閲覧資料を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I look at books on the same theme in the reading room?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request reading materials by subject in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一覧をご用意します。撮影は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will prepare a list. Please check photography permission separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示の貸出元名があっても撮影可とは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借用表示と撮影許可を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume photography is allowed just because the lending institution is named.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish a borrowing label from photography permission in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 閲覧室へはこの通路です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This passage leads to the reading room.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展示には触れず、一覧を持って閲覧室へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示を保持し閲覧室へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the exhibit untouched and take the list to the reading room.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the exhibit as it is and go to the reading room.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一覧をお渡しします。展示品はそのまま、こちらの通路で閲覧室へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the list. Leave the displayed items where they are and follow this passage to the reading room.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about mail after moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の住所へ届きました。以前の転送がまだ続くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所着と転送継続の思い込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It arrived at my old address. I thought my previous forwarding arrangement was still continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that mail reached the old address and you assumed forwarding continued.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し込みの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the application record?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。期間を見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込期間の未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I had not checked the period.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not checked the application period.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の扱いを担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check the current arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の申込を消さず、今の住所と経過を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元記録と現住所を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not erase the original application; I will show my current address and what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the original record and current address in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人には新住所を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told the senders your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一部だけです。この差出人にも直接変更を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未通知差出人へ変更連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only some of them. I will tell this sender directly about the change too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Notify a sender not yet informed of the address change in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の郵便はお手元ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have this piece of mail with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いえ、旧住居の管理者が保管しています。勝手に開けないよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧住居の保管状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, the manager of my old residence is holding it. I will ask them not to open it without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe how the mail is being held at the old residence in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録と保管状況を担当へ引き継ぎます。今後の転送相談と差出人への変更を分けて進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass the record and storage situation to the responsible staff. Please handle the consultation about future forwarding separately from notifying senders of the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更される情報は何ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場が変わりました。自宅住所は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場変更と自宅不変を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace has changed. My home address is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the workplace change and unchanged home address in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更対象の欄を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check which field needs changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この勤務先の欄です。郵送先まで新職場へ変える希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先と郵送先を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This employer field. I am not asking to change my mailing address to the new workplace too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the employer from the mailing address in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先名と所在地の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have documents showing the employer's name and location?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。入社予定でなく、今月から勤務しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在勤務と資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I have been working there since this month; it is not merely a planned start.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the materials and state that you currently work there in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自宅宛ての連絡は今まで通りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Contact sent to your home remains as before, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。電話番号も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先不変を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My phone number is the same too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your contact details are unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な確認を担当が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will carry out the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先名と所在地だけの変更として、内容を見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更対象だけを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to review the details as a change only to the employer's name and location.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm only the information being changed in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 勤務先情報の更新として受け付けます。自宅、郵送先、電話は変更希望なしで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-YOKOSUKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept this as an update to workplace information. We will confirm that you request no change to your home, mailing address, or phone.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の便は、まだ船長の運航判断を待っています。お申込み前のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-01.translation: The next sailing is still awaiting the captain's operating decision. Are you consulting us before booking?

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大人二人で乗りたいのですが、運航するか決まる前に支払う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人二人の乗船希望を述べ、運航判断前の支払いが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two adults would like to board. Do we have to pay before it is decided whether the sailing will operate?
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that two adults want to board and ask whether payment is required before the operating decision.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは判断が出てから購入をご案内します。お連れ様と一緒にお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, we guide you through purchasing after the decision is made. Will you wait with your companion?

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連れは待合室にいます。私は先に、この大きな旅行かばんを船へ持ち込めるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連れが待合室にいると答え、大きな旅行かばんの船内持込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion is in the waiting room. First, I would like to ask whether I can bring this large suitcase aboard.
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your companion is in the waiting room and ask about taking a large suitcase aboard.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きさだけでなく、船内で置ける場所も担当に確認します。預ける方法があれば、そちらもご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with the staff not just its size but whether there is a place for it aboard. If storage is available, would you also want that option?

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 船内に置けなければ陸上で預けたいです。ただ、貴重品は手元に残します。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 船内に置けない場合は陸上預かりを希望し、貴重品は手元に残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it cannot be placed aboard, I would like to leave it in storage on land. However, I will keep my valuables with me.
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would prefer shore-side storage if it cannot go aboard and will keep valuables with you.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、かばんの受入れ先を確認する間は、お持ちのままでお願いします。船酔いなど、ほかに気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please keep the bag with you while we check where it can be accepted. Is there anything else concerning you, such as seasickness?

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 揺れで気分が悪くなるのが心配です。今日は様子を聞いてから乗るか決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 船の揺れによる気分の悪化が心配で、案内後に乗船を決めたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am worried that the rocking may make me feel ill. May I decide whether to board after hearing about today's conditions?
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are worried about feeling ill from the boat's motion and would like to decide after the explanation.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。体調については判断できませんが、運航判断が出た際に船内の案内もお伝えします。先にお連れ様を呼ばれますか。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. We cannot judge your health, but when the operating decision is issued, we will also explain the arrangements aboard. Would you like to call your companion first?

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連れを呼んで、二人で説明を聞きます。支払いは、そのあとにします。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連れを呼んで二人で説明を聞き、支払いをその後にすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call them, and we will hear the explanation together. We will pay afterwards.
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to call your companion, hear the explanation together, and pay afterwards.

DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お戻りになったらこの窓口へお声がけください。運航と荷物の確認結果をお伝えします。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-KUM-AMAKUSA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please speak to us at this counter when you return. We will tell you the results of the operating and baggage checks. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今朝の担当は、この伝票にある箱の照合です。まず、箱の表示を読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This morning your job is to match the boxes on this slip. First, can you read the box labels?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 伝票は十二番ですが、こちらの箱には二十一番とあります。どちらから照合すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 伝票の十二番と箱の二十一番の食い違いを示し、照合の進め方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The slip says twelve, but this box says twenty-one. How should I begin the comparison?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the mismatch between slip twelve and box twenty-one and ask in Japanese how to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ荷物と決めず、その組合せを責任者に見てもらいましょう。箱はもう動かしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not assume they are the same shipment; let us have the person in charge look at that combination. Have you moved the box already?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ動かしていません。魚の見た目は隣と似ていますが、それで同じ箱とは判断していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱をまだ動かしておらず、魚の外観だけで同じ荷物と判断していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not moved it yet. The fish look similar to those next to it, but I have not judged it to be the same shipment from that appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not moved the box and have not identified the shipment from the fish's appearance alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それで結構です。番号の食い違いとして伝えます。持っている伝票には訂正の記載がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is good. We will report the number mismatch. Does the slip you have show a correction?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下の欄に手書きの数字があります。ただ、書いた人の名前がなく、訂正かどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 伝票の手書き数字に記入者名がなく、訂正か不明だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a handwritten number in the lower field. However, there is no writer's name, so I do not know whether it is a correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the handwritten number has no writer's name and it is unclear whether it is a correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その記載も一緒に確認します。別の箱の照合へ移る前に、通路の状態で気付いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check that entry too. Before moving to another box's comparison, did you notice anything about the passage?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の入口に水がたまっています。台車を通す前に、その場所も報告したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路入口の水たまりを具体的に伝え、台車を通す前に報告したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Water has pooled at the passage entrance. I would like to report that place too before taking a trolley through.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the puddle at the passage entrance and ask in Japanese to report it before taking the trolley through.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号の件と通路の件を分けて責任者へ伝えます。返事が来るまで、どの作業を保留するか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the person in charge about the numbers and passage separately. Let us confirm which work should be held until a reply arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この箱の移動は保留にして、照合済みの印も付けません。次に担当する箱は責任者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱移動と照合済みの印を保留し、次の担当箱は責任者に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hold off moving this box and will not mark it as checked. I will ask the person in charge which box to handle next.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hold both moving and marking the box as checked and confirm the next assigned box with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容で引き継ぎます。確認が済むまでここでお待ちください。いったんお疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will pass that on. Please wait here until the checks are complete. Thank you for your work so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しでしょうか。こちらの展示についてのご質問も伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something? We can also answer questions about this exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この道具の説明を家で読み返したいです。撮影不可の印がありますが、解説の札も撮れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影不可の展示について、解説札も撮れないか尋ね、家で読み返したい目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to read this tool's explanation again at home. There is a no-photography symbol; does that mean I cannot photograph the explanatory label either?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the explanatory label also cannot be photographed and explain that you want to read it at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示では札も撮影できません。短い解説を載せた配布紙ならあります。文字は小さくても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this exhibit, the label cannot be photographed either. We do have a handout with a short explanation. Are small letters all right for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい文字は読みにくいので、大きめの文字の資料があればそちらをお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さい文字は読みにくいと述べ、大きめの文字の資料を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Small print is difficult for me to read, so I would prefer material in larger print if available.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that small print is hard to read and request larger-print materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ内容の大きな文字の紙を用意できます。道具の名前だけでなく、使い方の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can prepare a large-print sheet with the same content. Do you need the explanation of how it is used, as well as the tool's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使い方も知りたいです。特に、二つの部品がどのようにつながるのかが読み取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具の使い方と、特に二つの部品のつながりを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know how it is used too. In particular, I could not understand how the two parts connect.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to know how the tool is used, especially how its two parts connect.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図では、長い部分と丸い部分を別々に示しています。実物には触れず、図を指して説明しますね。どちらが分かりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This diagram shows the long part and round part separately. I will point to the diagram and explain without touching the original. Which part is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸い部分のほうです。持ち手だと思っていたので、図の説明と読み違えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分かりにくいのは丸い部分で、持ち手と思って読み違えたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The round part. I thought it was the handle, so I misread the diagram's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the round part is unclear and you misread it because you thought it was the handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは丸い部分に関する説明からご案内します。あとで質問しやすいように、資料に展示番号を書いておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will start with the explanation of the round part. Shall I write the exhibit number on the materials so you can ask further questions easily later?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展示番号を書いてください。紙を読んでから、まだ分からないところだけ改めて質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料に展示番号を書いてもらい、読んでから不明点を改めて質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please write the exhibit number. After reading the sheet, I will ask again only about what I still do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the exhibit number on the materials in Japanese and say you will read them before asking further questions about remaining unclear points.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが大きな文字の資料です。展示番号も記しました。どうぞご自分のペースでご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the large-print materials. I have written the exhibit number too. Please read at your own pace.
